intelligence.essence: A smart note is distilled intelligence in the simplest words. A Naya Note is the FULL DEAL behind it — the full scope, the whole thing you could look at: the math, the technicals, the greater depth, the root, in three languages at once. One name, one thing: the back layer inside a smart note IS a Naya Note, and the standalone full-report document IS a Naya Note — same thing, two surfaces. Say "Naya note this" and it goes only in your personal feed, private, in your Smart Vault. On your feed it looks like a smart note, minus the social part.
